title: Categorized Free Recall with Closed-Loop Stimulation at Encoding (Encoding Classifier)
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial electrophysiology (iEEG) recordings from a categorized free recall task with closed-loop electrical stimulation during encoding. Participants studied lists of semantically categorized words, completed arithmetic distractors, and freely recalled the words. Stimulation was triggered by a classifier trained on each participant's prior encoding data to predict subsequent recall. Data were collected at multiple clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania.
methods_description: Participants with implanted intracranial electrodes performed categorized free recall of 12-word lists drawn from 25 semantic categories. An L2 logistic regression classifier was trained on spectral power features (Morlet wavelets, 3-180 Hz) from 0-1366 ms after word onset in prior catFR1 sessions. It was validated with leave-one-session-out cross-validation and permutation testing. During stimulation lists, 500 ms stimulation was delivered to a single electrode when classifier output fell below a participant-specific Youden's J threshold. Each session comprised 26 lists, and the first 4 lists had no stimulation.
